Inside, a tightly rolled page bore a faded handwritten note: Whoever finds this, the tide remembers you. Elena read it twice, then looked out at the endless water. She tucked the note into her coat, lit the lamp early that evening, and wondered who had written it, and how far the bottle had traveled before finding her shore.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一幅未干的水墨画。街灯还亮着，昏黄的光落在空荡荡的马路上，偶尔有一辆出租车缓缓驶过，车灯划开薄雾。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有零星几扇还亮着，像是有人仍在守夜或独自伏案。早点铺的蒸笼还没有揭开，环卫工人已经推着车，沙沙地扫过街道。远处的江水静静流淌，映着尚未苏醒的灯火。这座城市在睡与醒之间停顿了片刻，等待第一缕晨光，把它从沉默中轻轻唤醒。", "w03": "- Recursion means a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- Each call must have a simple base case that stops the calling, like counting down to zero.\n- It works like nesting dolls: you open one, find a smaller one inside, and keep going until the smallest one."}
